scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --outfile=app.js --define:__COMMIT_HASH__=\"$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)\" --define:__GA_MEASUREMENT_ID__=\"${GA_MEASUREMENT_ID:-}\" && sed -i -E "s/app\.js(\?v=[^\"]*)?/app.js?v=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)/" index.html
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --import tsx --test e2e/*.test.ts
